notes: The 2026.11.19-1 cut (ODL-340 follow-up: the tenant image learns its environment). It carries one signed installer change and the boot half that feeds it. (1) installer/odile_install.py serves ONE site name: render_caddy_site, ensure_caddy_site, wait_for_dns, wait_for_acme and certificate_fingerprint all read layout.fqdn, so --public-url names the Caddy site, the DNS and ACME waits and the certificate the recovery file pins; before this cut only webapp.public_url honoured it and a tenant in a second environment needed a test-site Caddy block and a config patch. The tenant default is <slug>.<the seed endpoint's host> (production keeps <slug>.odile.fyi), and the nightly backup's heartbeat default is <seed origin>/heartbeat instead of a production constant, so a bench tenant posts to the bench. (2) deploy/image/odile-release-setup.sh passes the measured odile.public_url= as --public-url (ODILE_RELEASE_PUBLIC_URL still overrides it on an operator re-run) and passes odile.seed_url= through, so a second environment needs no systemd drop-in. The boot record is unchanged: odile-firstboot posts it to odile.seed_url. release/manifest.json is the fresh-root document with only installer_sha256 re-derived by tools/recut_release.py, so this is a surgical re-cut, not a root rebuild; the skills artifact, the vendor pin and the meter-free rows are unchanged. The id is 2026.11.19-1: the served release was 2026.11.15-9, measured 2026-11-19T09:25Z, and 2026.11.16-1 is the committed-not-deployed cut this one supersedes; generated_at is later than every earlier cut. It is committed, not deployed.
